evals.name: rag-vector-db-lookup
evals.prompt: What does the AI wiki have on RAG and vector databases? Give me the relevant pages.

assertions.text: References the core [[rag]] concept page as a wikilink
References at least one vector-database entity page (e.g. [[pgvector]], [[pinecone]], or [[faiss]])
Returns results grouped by category (e.g. Concepts/Entities, Topics, Sources, Analyses)
Cites at least one source page (a wiki/sources/ page) as a wikilink
Uses Obsidian base:query and/or tag/search CLI commands rather than reading wiki/index.md wholesale

evals.name: context-engineering-research
evals.prompt: I'm researching context engineering — pull up everything in the wiki on it.

assertions.text: References the [[context-engineering]] concept page as a wikilink
References at least two additional related pages (e.g. [[context-rot]], [[context-compaction]], [[just-in-time-context]], [[structured-note-taking]])
Cites at least one source page (e.g. [[effective-context-engineering-anthropic]] or [[context-engineering-guide-promptingguide]])
Returns a ranked/grouped result set rather than a single undifferentiated list
Uses Obsidian CLI queries (base:query on Glossary.base, tag, or search) for retrieval
